Traditional tale: 孟母三迁

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
这是古代的故事。孟子小的时候，他的爸爸很早就去世了。从他的家到墓地很近，所以他每天老是从早到晚去墓地跟朋友们玩玩儿。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the visit to the cemetery, add a visual detail about the people there: “孟子看到有人在墓地哭，也有人带着花来祭拜。”
2. Show Mengzi’s reaction to make the scene more personal: “他觉得这些事情很有趣，就想学他们的样子。”

ideas.reason: “祭拜” is likely too advanced for this early-level learner.
It naturally explains why Mengzi begins copying the funeral activities he sees.
